36: pub fn uumain(args: impl uucore::Args) -> UResult<()> {

38: 
39:     let delete_flag = matches.get_flag(options::DELETE);
40:     let complement_flag = matches.get_flag(options::COMPLEMENT);
41:     let squeeze_flag = matches.get_flag(options::SQUEEZE);
42:     let truncate_set1_flag = matches.get_flag(options::TRUNCATE_SET1);
43: 
44:     // Ultimately this should be OsString, but we might want to wait for the

46:     let sets: Vec<_> = matches
47:         .get_many::<OsString>(options::SETS)
48:         .into_iter()
49:         .flatten()
50:         .map(ToOwned::to_owned)
51:         .collect();
52: 
53:     let sets_len = sets.len();
54: 
55:     if sets.is_empty() {
56:         return Err(UUsageError::new(1, "missing operand"));
57:     }
58: 
59:     if !(delete_flag || squeeze_flag) && sets_len < 2 {
60:         return Err(UUsageError::new(
61:             1,
62:             format!(
63:                 "missing operand after {}\nTwo strings must be given when translating.",

67:     }

74:                 sets[0].quote()
75:             ),
76:         ));
77:     }
78:

80:         let start = "extra operand";
81:         if delete_flag && !squeeze_flag {

86:                     start, op,
87:                 )
88:             } else {
89:                 format!("{} {}", start, op,)
90:             };
91:             return Err(UUsageError::new(1, msg));
92:         }
93:         if sets_len > 2 {
94:             let op = sets[2].quote();
95:             let msg = format!("{} {}", start, op);
96:             return Err(UUsageError::new(1, msg));
97:         }
98:     }

100:     if let Some(first) = sets.first() {
101:         let slice = os_str_as_bytes(first)?;
102: 
103:         let mut iter = slice.iter();

105:         if let Some(b'\\') = iter.next_back() {

124:     let stdout = stdout();
125:     let locked_stdout = stdout.lock();
126:     let mut buffered_stdout = BufWriter::new(locked_stdout);

129:     let translating = !delete_flag && sets.len() > 1;
130:     let mut sets_iter = sets.iter().map(|c| c.as_os_str());

132:         os_str_as_bytes(sets_iter.next().unwrap_or_default())?,

146:             translate_input(&mut locked_stdin, &mut buffered_stdout, op);
147:         } else {
148:             let op = DeleteOperation::new(set1);
149:             translate_input(&mut locked_stdin, &mut buffered_stdout, op);
150:         }
151:     } else if squeeze_flag {

153:             let op = SqueezeOperation::new(set1);
154:             translate_input(&mut locked_stdin, &mut buffered_stdout, op);

158:             let op = translate_op.chain(squeeze_op);
